---
name: Ownership model feedback
about: Share a concrete adoption condition, counterexample, or difficult source change
title: "[ownership feedback] "
labels: feedback
---

## Context

What kind of application or component library are you evaluating?

## Change you would make

Which DOM, behavior, or product-specific change would make you own the source rather than use props or slots?

## Guarantee you would keep

Can you identify that guarantee in the example Contract test? What evidence is missing or too coupled to Nagi's implementation?

## Adoption boundary

Which remaining package runtime, shared Contract, upgrade, or maintenance responsibility would make you adopt or reject this model?

Links to a real component or reduced counterexample are especially useful.
